briefdescription.para: Appointment entity bound to the clinics organisation and its appointment table.

detaileddescription.para: This is a thin concrete specialisation of Appointment. It fixes the table name ("clinics_appointments") and organisation name ("clinics"), forwards a payload to the base constructor, and exposes two static permission-query helpers by calling the shared Appointment implementations. It adds no state or logic of its own.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Controllers that work with clinic appointments construct this class so the generic Appointment code is tied to the right table and organisation. PermissionManager calls its two static helpers to authorise appointment actions. Without it, the shared permission logic would have no clinic- specific table and organisation names to work with.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
std::optional: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/utility/optional
Static constexpr member: a compile-time constant stored on the class; it can be used as a default argument or template value and needs no object.
static constexpr auto: lets the compiler deduce the type of the constant (here a string literal).
